Arithmetic worked examples set as number lines with rules, interleaved with running text. Italic caption centred above the passage. Catchword "Aliud" at lower right, below the last line. No margin notes.

head.i: Aliud exemplum ubi mentis reservatio adhibetur.

main_text.p: Princeps dedit alteri filiorum Coronatos 56789, quinquagies sexies millenos septingentos octoginta novem: alteri vero 1234, mille ducentos triginta quatuor.

Et dico: 4 & 9 sunt 13: Et subnoto 3 ac reservo 10. pro uno sequentis loci: Et dico sequenti loco: unum reservatum & 3 sunt 4: 4 & 8 sunt 12: subnoto 2, & reservo ut antea 10. pro 1. sequentis loci: ac dico 1 & 2 sunt 3: 3 & 7 efficiunt 10. Hic noto circulū, & 1 mente reservo: Et dico quarto loco 1 & 1 sunt 2: 2 & 6 sunt 8, quæ subscribo.
Quinto loco 5 sola reperio, quæ sola similiter subnoto. Inductio sic est:

page.notes: Small stray mark at left beside the "3 4 5" line, probably a printer's mark or stain; not transcribed. Rules between the number lines are not text and are omitted. Some numerals in the worked sums are small and slightly blurred ("1o", "3 ac"); read as 10 and 3 with reasonable confidence. "Quaeritur" may be "Quæritur" in print; the ligature is unclear at this scan resolution. Caption italic line ends with "adhibetur." as printed.
